info.title: AgentToll
info.description: Base mainnet data with x402 payments. Hosted prices: $0.001-$0.008 USDC. Self-hosted payment network and recipient are configured at startup; inspect /api/catalog and /.well-known/agent-card.json. PAYMENT-SIGNATURE sends authorization; PAYMENT-REQUIRED and PAYMENT-RESPONSE carry the quote and receipt.
